veranderings.voor: Staal is ook 'n geleier wat baie swakker as koper gelei.
veranderings.na: Staal is ook 'n geleier, maar dit gelei baie swakker as koper.
veranderings.rede: The relative clause reads as if it defines which kind of conductor steel is; a contrast with 'maar' says what is meant more clearly.
'tegen' is Dutch; the Afrikaans separable verb is 'teëhou', so 'hou dit teë'.
Two coordinate adjectives before a noun are separated by a comma.
The previous sentence calls it a 'stroombaan'; using one word for the same thing avoids a Grade 6 learner thinking a 'kring' is something else.

veranderings.voor: Die toets wys net wat aan die drade raak.
veranderings.na: Die toets wys net iets oor die deel wat aan die drade raak.
veranderings.rede: As written the sentence says the test shows what touches the wires, which is vague; the point is that it only tells you about the part touching the wires.

veranderings.voor: opgelos en dit laat die elektrisiteit deur
veranderings.na: opgelos, en hulle laat die elektrisiteit deur
veranderings.rede: 'dit' is unclear (water or the substances?) and should refer to the plural 'stowwe'; AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses.

veranderings.voor: Jou lyf gelei ook en nat vel laat dit baie makliker deur
veranderings.na: Jou lyf gelei ook, en nat vel laat elektrisiteit baie makliker deur
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb; 'dit' has no clear antecedent in this sentence, so name elektrisiteit.

veranderings.voor: dat 'n materiaal veilig is naby 'n sok nie
veranderings.na: dat 'n materiaal naby 'n sok veilig is nie
veranderings.rede: In a subordinate clause the verb goes to the end; the adverbial phrase comes before 'veilig is'.
The previous sentence speaks of 'isolators' in the plural, so the singular 'Die isolator' has no clear antecedent.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Hulle gelei baie swakker as metaal en 'n sel stoot te swak
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: This joins two clauses, each with its own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 requires a comma before 'en' ('...as metaal, en 'n sel stoot...'). I did not change it because the wording is protected; a person may want to add the comma in the protected entry itself.
